regulatory_descriptor: A non-linked, non-participating, individual, regular/limited premium payment, pure risk and savings life insurance plan
key_benefits: Death Benefit — Sum Assured on death paid as lump sum (or as monthly income for 5/10/20/30/40 years, or combination); not less than Guaranteed Death Benefit (105% of Total Premiums Paid)
Maturity Benefit — Sum Assured on Maturity returned ONLY under Variant 2 (ROP); Variants 1 (Life) and 3 (Easy) have NO maturity benefit

Early Exit Value — return of 100% of Total Premiums Paid; available ONLY under Variant 1 (Life), exercisable in the first 5 policy years after the life assured attains age 60 (subject to entry age <= 50, PT >= 35 years, maturity age >= 70)
Auto Cover Continuance Benefit — defer premiums up to 12 months keeping full cover (Variants 1 & 2; after 3 completed policy years)
Health Management Services — inbuilt wellness benefit (Variants 1 & 2)
Maturity Benefit in instalments option (ROP variant) — 120% of Maturity Benefit / 5 paid yearly over 5 years
riders_available: Bajaj Life Accidental Death Benefit Rider (UIN 116B034V02)
Bajaj Life Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Benefit Rider (UIN 116B036V02)
Bajaj Life New Critical Illness Benefit Rider (UIN 116B058V01)

eligibility.policy_term: Illustrations use 25-50 year terms (covering up to age 85); full PT range not captured in this parse. Early Exit Value requires PT >= 35 years.
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Regular or Limited; full numeric range not captured in this parse
eligibility.note: Eligibility boundary table not recovered from this parse — verify against policy document. Early Exit Value carries explicit sub-conditions: entry age <= 50, PT >= 35 years, maturity age >= 70.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from the date of receipt of the Policy Document; refund subject to proportionate risk premium, expenses and stamp duty; processed within 7 days.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days for premium frequencies other than monthly; 15 days for monthly. On non-payment: lapses if less than one full year's premium paid, else converts to paid-up.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death due to suicide within 12 months from date of commencement of risk or date of revival, nominee is entitled to at least 80% of Total Premiums Paid (or surrender/termination value if higher); no other benefit. Verify exact higher-of formula against policy document.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: Maturity Benefit (Sum Assured on Maturity) applies ONLY to Variant 2 (ROP). Variant 1 (Life) and Variant 3 (Easy) pay NO maturity benefit (pure term). Variant 1 instead offers an Early Exit Value (return of premiums) under strict conditions.
key_terms.tax_note: Premium, Maturity Benefit, Early Exit Value and Death Benefit may be eligible for tax benefits per the extant Income Tax Act, as amended — consult a tax advisor.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Disclaimer — policy document is the conclusive evidence of contract

claims_marketing_must_support: Any 'get your premiums back' / 'return of premium' / 'maturity benefit' claim is valid ONLY for Variant 2 (ROP) — must be variant-qualified; Variants 1 (Life) and 3 (Easy) pay NO maturity benefit.

Any 'exit and get your money back' claim refers to the Early Exit Value, which is ONLY under Variant 1 (Life) and is bound by strict conditions (entry age <= 50, PT >= 35 years, exercise in the first 5 years after age 60, maturity age >= 70).
Accidental-death, disability, critical-illness or family-protect benefits depend on the relevant optional rider (116B034V02 / 116B036V02 / 116B056V01 / 116B058V01) being attached.
Death Benefit floor '105% of Total Premiums Paid' (Guaranteed Death Benefit) is a minimum, not a return.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as a market-linked investment or wealth-creation product — it is non-linked, non-participating; the only 'savings' element is return-of-premium on the ROP variant.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'bonus' language — there are no bonuses (non-par); the only money-back is ROP (Variant 2) or Early Exit Value (Variant 1, conditional).
Do NOT present the Life or Easy variant as paying a maturity amount.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
